text: Carrying kindling: screen says 'Carrying kindling' but state.json player.carrying says 'firewood'; also no carried bundle visible in first-person view
After laying kindling (log already on andirons, checklist ticked), toast says 'Kindling laid. Now a split log or two on the andirons.' - stale instruction; should say strike a match

Checklist/brief lines render in two different font sizes/weights alternating (e.g. 'Ada arrives' and 'A rug before the hearth' large, 'She settles by the fire' small) - looks inconsistent; also 'Ada arrives' is ticked while the toast says her wagon is still coming up the trail

Restoration playback (T and auto reveal): last frame (12:00 Welcome) has the player's own avatar standing directly in front of the lit hearth, hiding the fire, and Ada is not yet in her chair - the payoff shot (fire + settler seated) is never shown. In the auto reveal one frame (10:20 Furnish) had the camera inside the player's top hat, the hat filling the lower third. See shots/replay_grid.png and shots/rev1.png

Ada seated: aiming at her labels her 'Rocking chair' (label drawn across her body), she has no face detail, and the quilt on her chair shows as a thin vertical striped slab standing up behind her shoulder, clipping the chair back

Outside after the fire has taken hold (hearthLit true): chimney is a plain dark grey box with no smoke, sparks or glow at the top, so from outside nothing says the hearth is lit. Also a thin dashed sliver sticks out past the right roof eave, and the 'Log wall, outside' aim label shows from ~10m away over the scene
pt walkto mare stops 1.5m from the mare and the camera is inside her neck/head: the whole left of the screen is a dark grey slab (shots/mare1.png); backing up 1.5s shows her fine
